taste_profile.design_read: High-craft Explainer Videos (Narrative Continuity Sequence): tactile physical realism paired with disciplined 'gold' palette typography and purposeful camera momentum; zero generic AI templates.
taste_profile.palette_discipline: Curated 'gold' palette with strict presenter skin-tone protection (grade: false on faces).
taste_profile.layout_variation: Alternating R_FULL hero framing with R_LOWER + Headout Action-Verb Stage and clean safe-zone outro.
taste_profile.reference_strategy: Zero-credit Nano Banana 2 Lite reference keyframes per scene family before Veo 3.1 / Seedance 2.0 motion generation.
anti_patterns: same camera shot size across 3 consecutive scenes
caption duplicating on-screen SerifLine headline verbatim
reusing the same hero-component spine across every beat
quality_gates: Every scene carries an explicit shot_intent and CHAI 5-aspect breakdown.
Signature depth device appears in at most 1-2 climactic beats.
